unDraw illustration library (Katerina Limpitsouni)

A free library of flat vector scenes whose accent color the user can change, named by Wired as one of the image banks that spread the style.

Read the unDraw license page and the Wired article. No illustration was downloaded, because the license forbids automated downloading without consent.

Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The license page says the images may be used free for commercial and non-commercial purposes without credit, but may not be redistributed in packs, used to build a competing service, or used for machine learning, and that the license does not extend to automated scraping or downloading. unDraw license.

Wired (24 January 2021): “Image banks such as FreePik, UnDraw, and Adobe’s own vector art library, have played a massive part in letting non-illustrators co-opt the Corporate Memphis style for themselves.” Wired.
